steps.note: 20 clients, 6 requests each (120 total). The limit is 30 per IP, and every client stays under it.

summary.verdict: 120 requests from 20 source IPs, 0 blocked. That is more than the 30-request limit, yet nothing tripped: no single IP ever exceeded it.

result.teaches: Per-IP rate limiting only sees one IP at a time. Spread the same volume across enough sources and it never triggers, no matter how large the total gets.
